comments.author: @kcnb28
comments.text: I believe the reason they break down as to do with context windows and LLMs not managing them properly. Sometimes they'll forget about what they're supposed to be doing right now and revert to a goal they were doing previously, or they forget what they just did. Sometimes they skip over certain details you provide or misinterprets them. Sometimes its too confident in its assessment of an issue or makes assumptions that it knows are assumptions, but doesn't verify if those assumptions are correct. These are the main reasons I've found for failures.
